messages:
maria: Heads-up — intermittent schema validation failures in the sample-app when the SDK retry wrapper kicks in for function calls. Repro steps below, seeing the function payload become a string on retry, then the server-side JSON schema validator complains.

maria: Repro: call with `jsonMode: true` + `retry: {retries:2}`. First attempt ok, retry sends body like "{\"title\":\"x\"}" instead of object.

maria: SDK snippet:
```js
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-oss-1',
  jsonMode: true,
  function_call: { name: 'create_issue', schema: issueSchema },
  retry: { retries: 2, backoff: 'exponential' }
})
```

ashok: @maria can you paste the raw outgoing http payload when the retry happens? my hunch: the retry wrapper re-serializes the whole request and double-encodes the `body` field. we had a similar pattern in older auth middleware. :eyes:

maria: pasted log (trimmed):
`OUTGOING -> { method: 'POST', path: '/v1/generate', body: '{"model":"redwood-oss-1","input":"...","function_call":"{\"name\":\"create_issue\",\"payload\":\"{\\\"title\\\":\\\"x\\\"}\"}" }' }`

ashok: yup that's double-stringified. The retry wrapper currently does `payload = JSON.stringify(req)` before sending, but when it reconstructs req for retry it starts from an already-stringified version. simplest fix: only stringify top-level if not already a string, and ensure `function_call.payload` is kept as object.

dev-bot: test-runner: 1 failing test in `sdk/retry-wrapper.spec.ts` -> failing case: preserves function payload type on retry.

sam: proposed one-liner fix in middleware: `if (typeof req.body !== 'string') req.body = JSON.stringify(req.body)` then `fetch(url, { body: req.body, ... })`. also add helper `cloneRequestForRetry(req)` that deep-clones objects instead of reusing serialized string.

olivia: agree on deep-clone + unit test. also we should update the sample-app quickstart note: "avoid enabling client-side retry until SDK >= X.Y.Z" so new signups don't hit this. i'll add a migration blurb. :+1:

maria: I'll open a PR with the guard + clone + test and link it to the sample-app issue. thanks all!

sam: if you want I can pair to add the test case for `function_call` objects — trivial but catches subtle re-serializations.

maria: great, pairing would be helpful. tagging this for devex triage.
